notes: - **New `get_reunderwrite_queue`.** The pieces existed — events resolve to the drivers they bear on, models know what they depend on, worldview drift flags theses — but nothing pushed; the user had to think to ask. The queue scans holdings and watchlist names and asks one question per name: has anything happened that bears on a driver this position depends on, **since it was last underwritten**? Reasons, loudest first: structural breaks (every fitted sensitivity spanning one is suspect), events bearing on a depended-on driver (grouped per driver via `model_link`), worldview drift under an asso
